blocks.html:
More about propeller shaft diameter

The propeller shaft diameter tool gives an estimate from the values you enter. Check the power, shaft speed and material inputs before reviewing the result. Keep these inputs so an engineer can compare the proposed arrangement. The estimate alone is not a manufacturing dimension for a specific shaft system.
